briefTitle: A Study Evaluating the Safety, Activity, and Pharmacokinetics of Divarasib as a Single Agent or in Combination With Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Participants With Previously Untreated Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With a KRAS G12C Mutation

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) of 0 or 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) of 0 or 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pre-treatment tumor tissue along with an associated pathology report is required for all participants enrolled on study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or requirement to provide a tissue biopsy is a procedure-based criterion, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically documented locally advanced unresectable or metastatic NSCLC that is not eligible for curative surgery and/or definitive chemoradiotherapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope, but there is no numbered stage list provided.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease, as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1. Additionally, for participants in cohort D, measurable brain metastases defined as at least 5 millimeters and twice the slice thickness, but less than 20 mm, that is asymptomatic and does not require local therapy at the time of enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST and specific brain lesion sizing are subjective imaging judgments, not typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known concomitant second oncogenic driver with available targeted treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant second oncogenic driver is a conditional rule not tied to a single typed biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Symptomatic, untreated, or actively progressing CNS metastases (Cohorts A, B, and C)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic, untreated, or actively progressing CNS disease is not a clean typed brain_mets exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known hypersensitivity to any of the components of divarasib or pembrolizumab; or known hypersensitivity to pemetrexed, carboplatin, or cisplatin (Cohort B only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity to specific drugs is not a standard prior therapy exclusion or typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, organizing pneumonia (e.g., bronchiolitis obliterans), drug-induced pneumonitis, or idiopathic pneumonitis, or evidence of active pneumonitis, active tuberculosis, significant cardiovascular disease within 3 months prior to initiation of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific medical and pulmonary histories are not typed criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of malignancy other than NSCLC within 5 years prior to initiation of study treatment, with the exception of malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death (e.g., 5-year OS rate more >90%), such as adequately treated carcinoma in situ of the cervix, non-melanoma skin carcinoma, localized prostate cancer, ductal breast carcinoma in situ, or Stage I uterine cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of other malignancies with conditional exceptions is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled tumor related pain, pleural effusion, pericardial effusion, or ascites requiring recurrent drainage procedures, uncontrolled or symptomatic hypercalcemia
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled symptoms and effusions are clinical judgment items.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Co-morbid condition that is an absolute contraindication to treatment with corticosteroids
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator-evaluated contraindication to corticosteroids is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Inability or unwillingness to take prophylactic treatments such as corticosteroids, anti-emetics, folic acid, or vitamin B12 supplementation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to take prophylactic treatments is a behavioral/judgment-based criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with brain metastases for whom complete surgical resections is clinically appropriate
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical appropriateness for brain metastases is a clinical judgment.
